plan.name: Pin native acceptance identities
plan.summary: Extend plumbing plans with explicit part, framework and exact selector metadata for Go testing, pytest, Vitest and Jest, validating and hashing the full identity and verbatim new regular source files while preserving every legacy Go hash and lock without inferred metadata or migration. Bind native execution to a deterministic identity of the trusted caller's captured repository contract and declared selection inputs, retain base provenance without tying validity to unrelated commits, and carry that authority through draft checks, locks, saved proposals, revisions, ratification, queued tools, staging, scope, builds and repairs. Show the complete identity and correctly highlighted sources safely in proposals and the dashboard, keep acceptance sources and selectors immutable under the fixed original baseline, and make configured results explicitly refuse unsupported or incomplete individual evidence so suite success, setup failure and the legacy Accepted fallback cannot qualify a draft or build. Keep external plumbing disabled, the existing Invariant Go runner operational and regression scope unchanged; update SPEC.md with existing decision citations, README.md within 400 lines, and schema and selector details in docs/factory.md to describe this contract and the pending adapters. The merger records the extension of D-0107 before the next issue, grounded in D-0105, D-0107, D-0108, D-0121, D-0122, D-0162, D-0173, D-0281, D-0294, D-0301 and D-0305 and the captured execution API from #484; decision recording and unavailable Docker or network checks are Merger work, while affected CI Python and TLAPS suites remain required.

tests.name: TestNativePlanReadsFourExactIdentities
tests.says: Go, pytest, Vitest and Jest retain exact part/framework/file/selector identities, same display names remain independent, source bytes are unchanged, and declaration order does not change the hash.

tests.name: TestNativePlanRefusesIncompleteAndAmbiguousIdentities
tests.says: Partial metadata, duplicate identities, mismatched paths, unsupported frameworks, wrong ownership or language, unavailable test_one and ambiguous Go selectors are refused without applying Go declaration rules to other languages.

tests.name: TestNativePlanLockPinsEveryIdentityAndExactSource
tests.says: Lock writing and reading preserve exact native sources and identities; source, selector, part, framework, file and execution-digest edits invalidate ratification.

tests.name: TestNativePlanBindsContentAuthorityRatherThanMovingRevisions
tests.says: Trusted captured configuration and declared inputs bind execution; changed policy is refused, identical policy at another commit is accepted without rewriting provenance, and drafts cannot supply authority.

tests.name: TestNativeMetadataCannotDowngradeToLegacy
tests.says: Explicit empty, null or partial native fields are refused instead of being interpreted as legacy Go records.

tests.name: TestNativeSourcesRefuseLinksExistingFilesAndExtraEntries
tests.says: Native acceptance sources must be new regular files with safe ancestors and no extra source entries.

tests.name: TestNativeStagingProtectsSourcesSelectorsAndOriginalRegressionScope
tests.says: Staging keeps ratified native sources and selectors from the fixed original checkout while preserving the existing Go regression allowance through repairs.

tests.name: TestNativeExecutionRefusesBeforePreparationAndKeepsIdentity
tests.says: All four native identities produce explicit unstarted or refused results until adapters exist, with full diagnostics and no dependency preparation or fallback to legacy execution.

tests.name: TestNativeBuildCannotBecomeReadyWithoutAnAdapter
tests.says: A native build without an execution adapter cannot pass checks, obtain review approval or become ready.

tests.name: TestConfiguredAcceptanceResultsNeverTreatSkippedEvidenceAsPass
tests.says: Configured suite success and legacy Accepted entries cannot turn skipped, running, refused or unstarted acceptance results into individual passes.

tests.name: TestConfiguredDraftNeedsIndividualEvidenceEvenAfterSuiteSuccess
tests.says: Setup failure and suite-only success cannot qualify a configured draft or build, including legacy-shaped acceptance records on the configured path.

tests.name: TestNativeQueueUsesRegisteredAuthorityAndCannotReplaceItsPlan
tests.says: The separate build test tool uses the queue's registered plan and captured authority; child-supplied policy or selectors cannot replace them.

tests.name: TestNativeExtensionPreservesPreChangeGoHashesAndCommittedLocks
tests.says: Pinned pre-change Go hashes and committed Invariant locks remain valid without inferred metadata, migration or a repository contract, while native selector changes affect hashes.

tests.name: TestNativeProposalShowsIdentityLanguageAndSafeNames
tests.says: Proposal comments and build prompts expose the full identity, render Python and TypeScript sources with their languages, and treat native labels as text.

tests.name: TestNativeSavedProposalAndRatificationRetainSelectors
tests.says: Saved proposal round trips retain identities and source bytes, and a ratification of one selector cannot authorize another.

tests.name: TestConfiguredPlanningCarriesCapturedAuthorityThroughChecksAndRevisions
tests.says: Planning checks in a separate process and final proposal creation share the caller's captured snapshot, preserve previous proposals on revision and refuse absent individual evidence.

tests.name: TestNativeProposalViewRetainsFullIdentityAndSource
tests.says: The dashboard proposal view retains complete native identities and sources for safe display to the person ratifying them.

tests.name: TestNativeAcceptanceScopePinsIdentityAndOriginalBaseline
tests.says: Scope accepts a valid native lock and rejects altered selectors, changed, missing or linked acceptance sources, existing unnamed test edits and expanded native regression scope.
